input.title: Stale reads from follower nodes (reads served locally without leader/commit check)
input.anomaly: With no faults and one client, w(x,8) completed at 455ms and w(x,9) at 493ms (both via leader n4). The next read(x) (#15, 494-511ms) sent to follower n5 returned 8, a stale value, so it can't be linearized.
causalChain: Cluster elects n4 leader at 203ms, no faults injected.
Client writes x=8 then x=9 through n4; both are acknowledged after commit on a majority.
With readFrom=any, read #15 goes to follower n5 at 494ms.
n5 has not yet applied the latest commit (x=9) and answers from its local state with x=8 without a read-index or leader lease.
The read returns a value overwritten by a write that completed earlier, which violates linearizability.
